facts.fact: Digital Realty (formerly iColo) opened its Nairobi Two (NBO2) colocation data centre in Karen, adding 6.4 MW to its Nairobi campus; the article gives no exact opening date, so the as_of is the publication month.
Digital Realty's Nairobi One (NBO1) data centre is already operational, forming with NBO2 a Nairobi campus of over 34,000 square metres and more than 14 MW of IT power, per the article.

note: NBO2 launch date given as 'Monday, August 7, 2026' which is inconsistent; as_of set to publication month. NBO1 as_of is publication date (operational then). LEED Silver is not a tier rating.
